title: lomagramma matthewii
intro: Lomagramma matthewii, commonly known as Matthew's fern, is a plant species belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lomagramma matthewii include anti-hypertensive, anti-inflammatory, and anti-oxidative effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of Lomagramma matthewii and its bioactive constituents.
